compiled_state.title: As a DSO ticket system, I need every ticket update to be followed by a re-read assertion so that silent write failures are caught as hard errors
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
ticket-update wrapper re-reads ticket after every write and asserts the written value matches the intended value. A mismatch is a hard error (non-zero exit + structured error output).

## Done Definitions
- ticket-update wrapper re-reads ticket after write
- Asserts written value matches intended value
- Mismatch is hard error (non-zero exit, structured error output)
- Read-after-write verification covers: create, update, tag, link, transition, comment operations
- Unit test: mock write failure -> assertion catches mismatch

## SC Coverage
SC14

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
